question: Within a bounded v1.3 static read set, does wonder item 207, The East India Company, reach an exact sea-tile trade, city-economy, completion, display, or AI consumer?

scope.boundary: This effect-specific packet tests exact references and split-address materialization for the East India record, description, and cost cell, then scans decoded literal or comparison uses of item 207 and decompiles the sole emitted function. It does not inspect the related terrain tile-yield evidence, expand unrelated callers, search every wonder or economy consumer, reconstruct display, or claim executable-wide absence.

dependencies.use: Provides exact item 207 identity, record, initialized description, and signed cost factor.
Provides the ordinary BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup path excluded from effect evidence.
Provides the related terrain-yield UEA ownership result.

acceptedSeed: Wonder item 207 at exact record 0x82F73B4C, with effect-description text at record +0xCA and ordinary cost at record +0x40.

acceptedAnchors.qualification: The initialized English description is a discovery hint, not proof of sea-tile trade execution.

referenceScan.qualification: Zero reference-manager results do not prove absence from undecoded, indexed, or split-constant paths.

splitAddressScan.negative: No decoded split construction matched the exact East India record, description, or cost cell.

itemIdScan.result: The complete filtered decoded-instruction scan emitted one comparison against 0xCF.

candidateResults.result: The function is a D3D format-name decoder. The comparison participates in packed format constant 0x182800CF and selects D3DFMT_LIN_A4R4G4B4_GPUENDIAN_16IN32.
candidateResults.stop: The exact 0xCF use is not wonder identity and the function carries no East India, tile, city-economy, completion, display, or AI state.

terrainYieldBoundary.result: The East India-specific read set produced no item-207 or record-derived edge into these functions.
terrainYieldBoundary.qualification: This evidence is distinct from, and does not change, the terrain-yield UEA ownership result.

ordinaryCostBoundary.result: The accepted item-207 cost path remains ordinary wonder production-cost evidence and is not effect consumption.
ordinaryCostBoundary.qualification: Cost selection alone cannot prove sea-tile trade, completion, display, or AI behavior.

boundedNegative.result: The completed bounded read set does not establish an exact East-India-to-sea-trade, city-economy, completion, display, or AI edge.
boundedNegative.limits: This negative covers three exact reference targets, the same three split-address targets, the complete one-function filtered scalar result, and complete function 0x82500288. It does not classify any indexed, indirect, dynamically dispatched, undecoded, or unsearched function.
boundedNegative.falsificationCondition: A complete exact function or independently bounded dataflow joins item 207 or East-India-record-derived state to sea-tile trade, city economy, completion, display, or AI consumption.

currentEvidence.method: Four sequential foreground read-only Ghidra queries: exact references, capped split constants, a filtered item-207 scalar-use scan, and one exact candidate decompilation.

entries.result: The record, description, and cost cell have zero reference-manager entries.
No exact target was materialized and the scan did not truncate.
Exactly one filtered comparison was emitted and the scan did not truncate.
The complete function proves the 0xCF comparison belongs to D3D format decoding, not wonder or gameplay state.

currentEvidence.qualification: The Ghidra project and flat image match the accepted v1.3 contract and were queried read-only without a project lock. No generated-code discovery, runtime probe, or indirect-target inference was used.

guards: Do not claim that no East India Company consumer exists outside the bounded read set.
Do not infer sea-tile trade from the initialized English description.
Do not treat ordinary cost selection through 0x82CF1278 as completion or effect evidence.
Do not reinterpret the D3DFMT 0xCF comparison as item identity.
Keep the terrain-yield UEA ownership result separate from this item-207 search.
conclusion: The bounded v1.3 static read set did not establish an exact East India Company sea-tile trade, city-economy, completion, display, or AI edge. Exact and split-address scans found no record-derived candidates. The complete filtered item-207 scan yielded one comparison, and complete function 0x82500288 proves it belongs to packed D3D format decoding rather than wonder identity. This is not an executable-wide absence claim and does not change the terrain-yield UEA ownership result.
